title: We did a LOT of compositing for these backgrounds for our visual novel
author: Visible-Key-1320
selftext: Each cat was generated separately (or sometimes as a group of two or three), then fitted into the image, and then edited/detailed in Photoshop. The theatre scene has 52 or 53 unique cats in the first three rows!

comments.author: erofamiliar
comments.body: That must've taken so much work, compositing is so annoying, lol. I think the final results turned out pretty good! I'm not a huge visual novel person, but I hope yours does well!

replies.author: Visible-Key-1320
replies.body: Yeah that's my luck. The AI people don't like VNs and the VN people don't like AI. Oh well! There's gotta be some crossover.

replies.author: edoc422
replies.body: Yea I was looking at using Adventure Forge, since it has some cool text replacement  options

comments.author: edoc422
comments.body: this is very impressive. I hope your VN does well I hope to make one in the future. what models are you using for the backgrounds?

replies.author: Visible-Key-1320
replies.body: Mostly Google Whisk, with touch-ups in NanoBanana via Photoshop Beta.

replies.author: Visible-Key-1320
replies.body: Do you have an engine in mind for yours?

replies.author: edoc422
replies.body: Yea I was looking at using Adventure Forge, since it has some cool text replacement  options

replies.author: Visible-Key-1320
replies.body: Oh neat. I've used RenPy, which is free and open source. Takes some getting used to, but it gets the job done!

comments.author: Annual_Grass538
comments.body: It’s stunning! I love it. So much care put into it.
